name: SlipStone
tagline: Every slip, every boat, every dollar — accounted for.
positioning: SlipStone is the operating system for small marinas: track slips, billing, and boaters in one place instead of a whiteboard and three spreadsheets.

hero.h1: Run your marina like you finally have the whole picture.
hero.sub: SlipStone replaces the dock whiteboard, the paper waitlist, and the spreadsheet you email yourself. Slip assignments, seasonal contracts, and billing in one honest system.

features.title: Live slip map
features.description: See every slip, its occupant, contract dates, and vessel length on one dock diagram. Drag a boat to reassign it and billing updates automatically.

features.title: Seasonal contracts
features.description: Renew annual and transient agreements in a few clicks. SlipStone tracks proration, deposits, and the waitlist so nobody double-books C-14.

features.title: Dockside billing
features.description: Auto-invoice slip rent, metered power, and pump-out fees. Boaters pay by card or ACH and you stop chasing checks at the fuel dock.

features.title: Waitlist that actually works
features.description: Rank prospects by requested length and season, then offer openings by text. No more sticky notes taped to the harbormaster's monitor.

features.title: Vessel & insurance records
features.description: Store registration, insurance expiry, and haul-out history per boat. Get flagged before a certificate lapses on a boat in the water.

features.title: Staff on the same page
features.description: Dockhands, office, and owner see the same live data from phone or desk. Add a seat when you hire, drop it when the season ends.

testimonials.quote: We ran 140 slips out of a binder and a wall calendar. SlipStone caught three boats we'd been under-billing all season. It paid for itself by June.
testimonials.name: Dana Reinholt

testimonials.quote: The live dock map is the whole thing for me. New dockhands learn the layout in a day and stop radioing me every time someone wants a transient slip.
testimonials.name: Marco Villanueva

testimonials.quote: Renewal season used to eat two weeks. Now contracts and deposits go out in an afternoon and boaters sign on their phones. My office is quiet again.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
